decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Subject to appropriate safeguarding conditions, the proposed extensions to the existing office building, because of their scale, position, and compatible appearance, would be acceptable in this out of town centre location, would not harm the character and appearance of the property or the street scene, and would not harm neighbours' living conditions. The proposal would therefore accord with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New development), E-1.1 (Location of new employment development), E.1.2 (Location for business (B1) use) and T.1.4 (Car and cycle parking and servicing facilities for developments).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - The site shall be investigated for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and details of the test results and measures required to render the development safe shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.

Where measures are required, they shall be installed before the development is occupied or such other time as may be required by the Local Planning Authority
description: Erection of a two storey side extension and single-storey front extension to office building with associated parking and landscaping.
